| description = He doesn't trust the bank to hold his money and as a result he has a tendency to carry lots of platinum. It varies from around 2 to 5 platinum. He has a 6 minute respawn time.

* Tol Nicelot that spawns in Erudin's Library will NOT be assisted by the guards. (Respawn timer is 6:40,  tested on green server)

* Tol Nicelot that spawns in Erudin's Library is KOS for my Erudite Necromancer, I'll confirm that the guards do not assist, and i just pull with aggro as he walks by the door, let my pet occupy him long enough to darkness, then run him down to the toxx zoneline to fear kite. He will heal himself, so I keep him feared at all costs and burn him down quick, then med to full well before the next respawn.

* If [[Mikeana Tolstaub]] aggros during a pull, zone out, and expect that the next pull you make is gonna suck. She apparently buffs him with something that gives him close to double his usual HP.

* One of the possibly 24 minute spawns in Qeynos Hills that starts at West Karana and paths to North Qeynos then despawns. Shares this spawn with several NPCs, including [[Sir Edwin Motte]], [[Guard Westyn]], [[Wyle Bimlin]], [[Isabella Cellus]], [[Tol Nicelot]], [[Gornolin]], [[Crumpy Irontoe]], [[Talym Shoontar]] and [[Barn Bloodstone]], all of whom seem to be characters from other zones on a trip to Qeynos.
